expanded_name: Cross-View Latent Reconstruction Adapter for X-VLA

closest_external_prior.name: WristWorld: Generating Wrist-Views via 4D World Models for Robotic Manipulation
closest_external_prior.author_stated_mechanism: A two-stage 4D world model estimates wrist poses and point-cloud projections with VGGT/SPC, then generates temporally coherent wrist-view videos from anchor views with a video generator.
closest_external_prior.author_stated_positive_result: The paper reports a 3.81% increase in CALVIN average task-completion length and closure of 42.4% of the anchor-wrist gap.
direct_overlap: anchor/agent-view observations are used to recover wrist-view information
paired multi-view robot data supplies wrist-view supervision
the recovered wrist information is intended to improve downstream VLA behavior
not_exact_overlap: WristWorld reconstructs geometry and synthesizes wrist-view pixel videos; CVLR predicts the existing X-VLA Florence2 wrist latent block directly
WristWorld augments VLA training data while leaving the downstream VLA architecture unchanged; CVLR is a small frozen-policy token adapter active only when the live wrist input is missing
WristWorld uses VGGT, wrist-pose/point-cloud projection, SPC loss, and video diffusion; CVLR uses paired clean X-VLA latent regression without pixel/video generation
CVLR preserves the original clean X-VLA path exactly and replaces only the missing auxiliary wrist-token block

secondary_overlap_checks.name: Multi-View Masked World Models for Visual Robotic Manipulation
secondary_overlap_checks.overlap: view masking and cross-view reconstruction from multi-camera robot data
secondary_overlap_checks.distinction: MV-MWM reconstructs pixels to pretrain an autoencoder and then learns an RL world model on frozen representations; it does not reconstruct a missing wrist latent inside a frozen VLA action path.

secondary_overlap_checks.name: Robot Learning with Sensorimotor Pre-training
secondary_overlap_checks.overlap: masked prediction of latent visual and sensorimotor tokens
secondary_overlap_checks.distinction: RPT is general trajectory pretraining across modalities and time followed by policy fine-tuning; it does not target live wrist-camera dropout or inject reconstructed wrist tokens into an existing frozen VLA.

secondary_overlap_checks.name: ReconVLA: Reconstructive Vision-Language-Action Model as Effective Robot Perceiver
secondary_overlap_checks.overlap: a reconstruction objective is coupled to VLA learning
secondary_overlap_checks.distinction: ReconVLA reconstructs task-specific gaze-region scene tokens for implicit grounding; it does not reconstruct a missing wrist view from another camera.
